A level Physics · Motion · Projectile motion

Projectile motion

Fire a projectile horizontally from a cliff, at an angle from a cliff, or at an angle from level ground. The horizontal and vertical motions are independent: constant velocity across, constant acceleration g downwards. Air resistance is ignored.

Scale 1 : 1 Strobe images every 0.20 s Set the launch conditions, then fire.

Try these

Key equations
v = u + at
s = ut + ½at²
v² = u² + 2as
s = ½(u + v)t

Use them separately for each direction. Horizontally a = 0, so s = uxt. Vertically a = −g. Time t is the only quantity shared by both directions.
